title: Old-time New Orleans players had to read
summary: They remember good bass, banjo, clarinet and trumpet players in New Orleans and agree you could not join a band unless you read.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Reading music versus faking and playing by ear
